name: Delivery callbacks, deduplication and suppression

steps.action: Verify provider signature and delivery semantics
Deduplicate by source event and send reference
Classify bounce, complaint, deferral or unsubscribe
Update Mautic and provider suppressions promptly
Reconcile affected queued and unknown attempts

failure: Set the affected marketing sender/campaign to HOLD; retain unknown acceptances and quota reservations pending reconciliation. Update authoritative suppression before releasing further sends.

run_contract.owner: Assigned accountable role in OpenProject before activation
run_contract.retry: Bounded retry only after retryability classification; unknown remote effects HOLD
run_contract.observability: workflow_id, run_id, correlation_id, state and redacted error; no raw PII labels
run_contract.recovery: Restore HOLD; reapply suppression/deletion and reconcile external receipts before replay
run_contract.completion: Named output plus acceptance evidence, not merely a running service
